svg.aria-label: Electrical block diagram: Ulysses LARS Charger, 29 blocks, 8 rails, 19 buses
svg.text: generated from block-diagram.yaml — edit the spec, not this file
U3 250 mA U1 90 mA U2 90 mA U9 40 mA U6 4 mA
U25 500 mA U22 200 mA U20 50 mA U13 40 mA U27 4 mA
U23 400 mA U12 100 mA U24 35 mA U11 15 mA
U1 · TX bridge leg A (2x GaN)
U2 · TX bridge leg B (2x GaN)
TX_ADC · ANALOG · tank current, 1 MHz chain per ELE-010
TX_PWM · OTHER · TIM1 complementary pairs with explicit dead time per FW-004
RX_LSK · OTHER · load-shift keying drive, blanked against the TX tracker per FW-009
VEH_LINK · UART · RX controller to HVLV controller, vehicle-side coordination
HVLV_ISO · OTHER · phase-shift PWM across the isolation barrier
PWR_TX_TANK · OTHER · TX bridge output into the series compensation
PWR_LINK · OTHER · THE AIR GAP. 3 kW at 8.33 A rms, k >= 0.40, and the in-band data link of SYS-012 rides on this same path.
LSK_TAP · OTHER · load-shift keying modulates the RX tank; TX sees it on U8
DAMP_TAP · OTHER · handshake damping network across the TX tank
▼ bus controller · ● bus member · pill on a block = the rail it runs from · every colour is also labelled
